3. Restoration is a physical operation, not a ledger deletion

The metered-exchange return gives61.93 operational human hours/year against476.4 for strong assistance. Tenfold allows47.64, leaving14.29h/year to remove through actual operations. Its listed15h intervention/reset term is large enough only if at least95.2667% of that whole term can be eliminated while the other preparation/calibration/stock/renewal work is unchanged. Eliminating the entire15h would conditionally leave46.93h and10.1513-fold reduction; no autonomous rack has been constructed by this arithmetic. The corresponding direct wage change is only.11432USD per exchange at5000/year and40USD/h, not an invented large full-cost advantage.

Finite mechanical rack restoration could use accessible cartridge exchange, positive location against a master and independent gripping of all captured fragments, with paid replacement/waste and a proof before returning a kit to stock. A seized cut-blade attachment, neck debris, worn land, failed gauge or unreset lock still needs a physical sequence and unavailable/qualified states. A quarantine label does not restore a functional kit. The16 circulating kits in the simulated500-exchange campaign do not establish500 uses of each kit. The complete useful operation also retains real load transfer, original-contact removal, final absence of temporary paths and both seized-member/seized-foot retrieval.
